card.name: Names of people after titles or initials
card.fires_on: Personal first or last names in running prose, usually right after a title, role word or initial such as Judge, Lead author, or a middle initial. The surname or first name is about to be followed by another name.

modes.label: Name after initial
modes.description: A surname or given name following a middle initial or first initial.
modes.example: Duke assistant professor of medicine Benjamin J.<< Powers>>, MD, who led the research team

modes.label: Name after a title
modes.description: A first name right after a role word like Judge or Chief Judge, before the surname.
modes.example: In the Seattle case, Judge<< Alex>> Kozinski, a Reagan appointee

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens are scattered and mixed-language fragments.
card.plain: It lights up on a person's name in the middle of a full name, especially after a title or initial.
